title: Part 3 · 01
prompt: What concerns the customer about the digital proof?
options: The photographs are missing.
Some text is difficult to read.
The museum name is incorrect.
The number of copies is too small.
explanation: 正确答案为B。A：顾客明确说照片看起来不错，不是照片缺失；B：顾客说小字号图注在电脑上难以看清；C：对话没有提到名称错误；D：五百份是印刷数量，没有说数量不足。
evidence: the small captions are hard to read on my laptop.
transcript:
customer: I received the digital proof for our museum leaflet. The photographs look good, but the small captions are hard to read on my laptop.
print_clerk: Before we print all five hundred copies, I suggest making one paper sample. The text may look different at its actual size.
customer: Good idea. Could you make the sample on the matte paper we selected? The glossy version reflected the exhibition lights last year.
print_clerk: Certainly. You can collect it after two this afternoon. We will wait for your approval before starting the full run.
customer: Thanks. I will bring it to the museum and check it under the display lights.
print_clerk: Please call me afterward, even if no changes are needed.
translation:
customer：我收到了我们博物馆宣传单的电子样稿。照片看起来不错，但小字号的图注在我的笔记本电脑上很难看清。
print_clerk：在印刷全部五百份之前，我建议先做一份纸质样张。文字在实际尺寸下看起来可能不同。
customer：好主意。能用我们选的哑光纸做样张吗？去年的光面版本会反射展厅灯光。
print_clerk：当然可以。今天下午两点后您可以来取。在开始整批印刷前，我们会等您确认。
customer：谢谢。我会把它带到博物馆，在展厅灯光下检查。
print_clerk：之后请给我打电话，即使不需要改动也请联系。
问题：顾客对电子样稿有什么顾虑？
A. 照片缺失。
B. 有些文字难以看清。
C. 博物馆名称有误。
D. 印刷份数太少。

supplier：不用存那么久。我们的司机每周三都经过你们那条街，可以那时收走箱子。你们平常周一的配送安排不变。

supplier：每个箱子需要支付可退押金，但配送费不增加。我们收到箱子后就退回押金。
